# 升级实施交接规范：给后续出题 agent

适用日期：2026-09-27。与各 `paper_id.md` 顶部的“首版实施规格”一起使用。本文件指导**出题方开发参考和任务**；不是要求被评估的 AR agent 照抄固定路线。升级是否成立取决于它是否新增需要证据检验的科学判断，不能以作业更多、方法更贵或填写假设字段代替。

## 1. 如何读取这些方案

读取顺序：本规范 → [分批审查报告](upgrade_guidance_review_20260927.md) → 单篇顶部规格 → 单篇正文/SI证据与原始结果链接 → 现行 final 任务及 evaluator。单篇顶部定义首版必需范围；下面较早方案保留研究背景和扩展设计。早期“建议C”不自动成为本轮首版要求，未启用的扩展不能混入关键失败项。

当前 final 覆盖89篇，其中AR85篇、仅PR4篇。首版升级候选71个AR，另14个AR保留或先修基线；4篇仅PR是新建AR候选。hold不进入实施清单。档案中旧PASS、runner完成、迁移到final都不证明新增科学目标已验证。

## 2. 动笔改任务前，先冻结六项科学定义

以下是实施 agent 必须完成的准备产物，本次文档审查没有声称它们均已完成：

| 准备项 | 具体要求 | 未满足时的处理 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 对象清单 | 每个物种/控制有稳定ID、连接图、原子映射、化学计量、电荷/自旋、源文图表或新增模型标记；扫描给出具体映射原子 | 缺对象身份先整理，不从示意图猜坐标后当源事实 |
| 最低对照矩阵 | 列出处理因素、保持不变因素、主对象/反例/独立检验；区分化学替换与纯几何干预 | 一次改变多因素只能作复合比较，不能宣称纯单因素因果 |
| 观测定义 | E/G、温度/标准态、反应零点、谱峰/态身份、单位、公式和误差来源固定 | 不能用最接近作者数值的物理量替换目标 |
| 主方法与敏感性 | 从单篇源路线/正确基线建立可计算主协议，记录泛函、基组/ECP、溶剂、态、收敛；敏感性另列 | 方法可允许自主选择，但必须先证明合理方法范围的参考可比性 |
| 数据边界 | 实验观测作为解释输入可以公开；待预测/构型答案及作者终态、机制标签、参考输出私有 | 同一观测不能同时作为提示和盲测答案；文件名/坐标也检查泄露 |
| 判据与预算 | 每一必需端点对应可解析原始产物、容差来源及失败语义；先导实测后设引擎次数/小时上限 | 不从工作包数估算调用次数，不先填未经新计算支持的阈值 |

不得强迫后续 AR agent 采用唯一控制路线。出题方的控制矩阵用于证明可行性和设定科学覆盖；正式题公开研究问题、可用数据、有限对象/预算与完成标准，让 agent 自主选择能区分解释的实际计算。等价且科学充分的对照可被接受。

## 3. 建立可审查的新参考

1. **先导验证。** 先复核一个正确旧端点，再运行本篇指定的最关键新增控制。旧端点与当前任务不同就先解释版本/身份/物理量差异，不能复制旧PASS。软件自测与此处的科学端点是两回事。
2. **最低完整参考。** 实际完成顶部规格的核心矩阵，保留初猜、失败/重启和最终结构。固定几何点用于干预诊断，不冒充自由极小值。非平稳点不得随意套用其他结构的热修正。路径对照要证明反应坐标与端点，不能只凭一个虚频。
3. **可否证性。** 至少一项对照确实能挑战首选解释。计算支持作者、否定作者、或在测定误差内不可区分都可以是科学结果；但“没有算到必需端点”只能是未完成，不等于有界不可识别。
4. **稳健性。** 对决定结论的一个模型/方法/构象/数值设置作敏感性检查。若排序差小于不确定度，定义支持集合或不可排序区间，不能强制单个赢家。
5. **冻结数值。** 将源文值、旧真实结果、新增参考值和推断分列。新容差依据实验提取误差、数值收敛、方法/构象敏感性和等价路线参考确定；相对变化与绝对值分别校准。不得机械沿用旧端点的±阈值，更不得事后放宽到覆盖任意错误对象。

## 4. evaluator 的最低实现要求

实施时不必照抄以下文件名，但必须有同等可追溯关系：对象表、原始作业索引、主观测/控制差异表、假设–证据–结论表、资源记录、公开/私有数据清单。它们是出题方参考设计，不能把作者路线或赢家经这些文件泄露给AR。

验收顺序：

1. **身份与有效性**：守恒、原子映射、电子态、收敛、驻点/路径/周期模型符合要求。
2. **必需计算覆盖**：顶部核心矩阵中每一科学比较有真实结果，允许有证据的候选坍缩/排除，但不将一次不收敛当全空间不存在。
3. **可重算数值**：从引用的原始文件能重算关键量及差值，定义/单位一致，数值满足已冻结的参考范围。
4. **科学判断**：结论与干预及反例一致，指出仍无法区分的因素；不依赖照抄作者叙述获取高分。

发布前至少准备四类评分样例：完整有效结果；完成对照后得到合理否定/不可识别；只提交旧数值而缺新控制；错身份/错态/错能量零点。新框架必须拒绝后两类，不把格式分或“诚实失败”加到科学通过。可选扩展不计入首版硬失败。

AR/PR 使用同一个科学对象、观测定义、容差和完成判据。PR可暴露作者路线，AR保留独立研究选择。实际结果可证明同一科学问题可计算，但不能补造历史AR自主决策轨迹。

## 5. 软件范围与替代边界

以当前完整版 [chemistry_toolbox](../../../chemistry_toolbox/README.md)、[原生程序指南](../../../chemistry_toolbox/config/native_software_guides.yaml)、[运行时配置](../../../chemistry_toolbox/config/mcp_profiles.yaml) 为依据。原生入口缺少专用Action不等于软件不能算；软件存在也不等于具体新模型已验证。

| 科学工作 | 默认参考工具范围 | 需要额外校准的边界 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 分子基态/频率/热化学 | Gaussian或ORCA；CREST/xTB辅助初猜；GoodVibes可作统一热化学后处理 | xTB最低点/势垒不直接顶替目标DFT；不同程序的同名溶剂/色散/基组先核对 |
| TD、NMR、ECD、响应、EPR | Gaussian/ORCA原生功能，Multiwfn等分析已导出的波函数/密度 | NTO/态映射、核种/符号、响应张量、SOC与根窗口；功能存在不等于可靠方法 |
| TS/IRC/有限机制 | Gaussian/ORCA与pysisyphus；PyFrag仅在碎片及路径定义一致时使用 | 同一势面端点、守恒、局部/共同零点、标准态；扫描峰不是自动TS |
| 统计/连续模型 | 允许的Python/SciPy环境 | 必须有真实数据、物理模型和可识别性，不能拟合任意函数冒充机制 |
| 周期/表面/界面 | GPAW/QE/CP2K等已配置后端，ASE辅助 | 赝势、晶胞、磁态、表面/真空/k点及尺寸收敛按本题建立 |
| 多参考/能量分解/体相/输运 | 按单篇有条件启用ORCA/PySCF/Psi4/GROMACS等 | 活性空间、碎片、力场、电荷、采样和接口各有独立参考要求；NEGF仍在阻塞队列 |

首版不要求安装新商业软件。将NBO等许可或专门接口列为必需之前先核实实际可调用范围；替代分析需证明支持同一科学观测，不能静默更换量的定义。SIESTA的现有原生指南仅列siesta入口，不能由此推定完整偏压TBtrans链已允许且跑通。

## 6. 资源与每批完成条件

资源逐作业记录：实际科学引擎启动数、成功/失败/重启、分配CPU核数、有效计算小时、CPU核小时；有进程累计CPU时间则单独列。作业小时求和与并行日历跨度分列。多段Link1/多个扫描点未重新启动引擎时不分别计启动；后处理分析不算科学引擎调用。估算值必须标预计，参考完整跑完后才填实测。

批次不是必须整批成功后才能继续的硬依赖。某篇满足自身入口和资源条件可推进，另一篇阻塞则留在准备队列。每篇完成顺序为：数据和定义冻结 → 最关键控制试算 → 最低完整参考及稳健性 → 两模式任务/评分同步 → 无作者答案泄露的独立试运行 → 对照原始结果审查。未完成新增参考时，只能称“方案/参考开发中”，不能称“升级版验证通过”。

## 3. 科学边界与来源纠正

1. **苄醇：** Iₑ 与 Dₑ 均为约定的电子能差，不混入 ZPE/G，不把气相电离当绝对电极电位。单一 H 原子参考必须一致。检验预测可为数值或排序；已经看过结果时如实采用回顾检验，不能补造盲预测历史。
2. **环氧片段：** 作者方法段是 B3LYP-D3(BJ)，图注出现 CAM-B3LYP 的不一致已在 PR 中披露。以方法段为复现基线、其他层级单独列。分子偶极不等于树脂 Dk；对任意取向偶极向量求和不能代替 ⟨μ²⟩。
3. **并环戊搭烯：** NICS 使用完整张量对分子法向投影。源文正文和 SI 的响应基组不一致，PR 明确采用 SI 基线并披露差异。冻结骨架控制不能冒充自由极小值。
4. **锌配合物：** 对角 G 和交叉几何电子能分开；允许真实构象塌缩，不强造四个不同极小值。后 SCF D3 的同几何开关不能被解释成直接电子密度干预。红移与增强振子强度分开判断。
5. **铱硝酸根：** 从公开输入移出直接揭示 eta2 的旧 X-ray 参数，改为不固定金属—硝酸根连接的组成定义和未指派 IR。PR 将 eta2 作为作者假设提供。1532/1261/1223/802 与另含 1561 cm⁻¹ 的两套观测均需比较；源文没有明确通用数值缩放因子，不能冒称作者给定。
6. **发色团：** 补入 PQCZCS 的完整身份；其与 AQ 是同分异构体，不可混为一物；SI `[M+H]+` 分子式不作为中性计算式。AR 不预先提供特定分子的 CT/局域态赢家；PR 作者解释与新增共同扭角设计分开。

## 4. 科学评分和完成标准

科学评分总分为 100：对象/有效性 10，三项各篇特定研究端点合计 65，实际假设检验和定量稳健性 15，有证据的结论 10。新增对照、能量分解、系综或态匹配都进入评分，旧标量加一段机制文字不足以完成新版。

评分规则要求从原始文件核对定义、覆盖、数值相减、权重、张量投影、谱残差或态对应。对于拓展范围，现阶段使用有具体证据要求的条件/语义规则；**尚未伪造新的数值参考和容差**。源文数值及旧实际结果仅作为相同定义的基线参考；完整新增参考和方法敏感性建立后，才可冻结可接受数值范围。

计算支持作者、反驳作者，或完成充分对照后仍存在不可区分性，都可构成有效科学结论。少算一个必需端点、一次不收敛或没有执行对照，不等于完成了“不可识别性”研究。`bounded_failure` 可被提交格式接受，但不自动获得科学通过。

# 升级实施交接规范：给后续出题 agent

适用日期：2026-09-27。与各 `paper_id.md` 顶部的“首版实施规格”一起使用。本文件指导**出题方开发参考和任务**；不是要求被评估的 AR agent 照抄固定路线。升级是否成立取决于它是否新增需要证据检验的科学判断，不能以作业更多、方法更贵或填写假设字段代替。

## 1. 如何读取这些方案

读取顺序：本规范 → [分批审查报告](upgrade_guidance_review_20260927.md) → 单篇顶部规格 → 单篇正文/SI证据与原始结果链接 → 现行 final 任务及 evaluator。单篇顶部定义首版必需范围；下面较早方案保留研究背景和扩展设计。早期“建议C”不自动成为本轮首版要求，未启用的扩展不能混入关键失败项。

当前 final 覆盖89篇，其中AR85篇、仅PR4篇。首版升级候选71个AR，另14个AR保留或先修基线；4篇仅PR是新建AR候选。hold不进入实施清单。档案中旧PASS、runner完成、迁移到final都不证明新增科学目标已验证。

## 2. 动笔改任务前，先冻结六项科学定义

以下是实施 agent 必须完成的准备产物，本次文档审查没有声称它们均已完成：

| 准备项 | 具体要求 | 未满足时的处理 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 对象清单 | 每个物种/控制有稳定ID、连接图、原子映射、化学计量、电荷/自旋、源文图表或新增模型标记；扫描给出具体映射原子 | 缺对象身份先整理，不从示意图猜坐标后当源事实 |
| 最低对照矩阵 | 列出处理因素、保持不变因素、主对象/反例/独立检验；区分化学替换与纯几何干预 | 一次改变多因素只能作复合比较，不能宣称纯单因素因果 |
| 观测定义 | E/G、温度/标准态、反应零点、谱峰/态身份、单位、公式和误差来源固定 | 不能用最接近作者数值的物理量替换目标 |
| 主方法与敏感性 | 从单篇源路线/正确基线建立可计算主协议，记录泛函、基组/ECP、溶剂、态、收敛；敏感性另列 | 方法可允许自主选择，但必须先证明合理方法范围的参考可比性 |
| 数据边界 | 实验观测作为解释输入可以公开；待预测/构型答案及作者终态、机制标签、参考输出私有 | 同一观测不能同时作为提示和盲测答案；文件名/坐标也检查泄露 |
| 判据与预算 | 每一必需端点对应可解析原始产物、容差来源及失败语义；先导实测后设引擎次数/小时上限 | 不从工作包数估算调用次数，不先填未经新计算支持的阈值 |

不得强迫后续 AR agent 采用唯一控制路线。出题方的控制矩阵用于证明可行性和设定科学覆盖；正式题公开研究问题、可用数据、有限对象/预算与完成标准，让 agent 自主选择能区分解释的实际计算。等价且科学充分的对照可被接受。

## 3. 建立可审查的新参考

1. **先导验证。** 先复核一个正确旧端点，再运行本篇指定的最关键新增控制。旧端点与当前任务不同就先解释版本/身份/物理量差异，不能复制旧PASS。软件自测与此处的科学端点是两回事。
2. **最低完整参考。** 实际完成顶部规格的核心矩阵，保留初猜、失败/重启和最终结构。固定几何点用于干预诊断，不冒充自由极小值。非平稳点不得随意套用其他结构的热修正。路径对照要证明反应坐标与端点，不能只凭一个虚频。
3. **可否证性。** 至少一项对照确实能挑战首选解释。计算支持作者、否定作者、或在测定误差内不可区分都可以是科学结果；但“没有算到必需端点”只能是未完成，不等于有界不可识别。
4. **稳健性。** 对决定结论的一个模型/方法/构象/数值设置作敏感性检查。若排序差小于不确定度，定义支持集合或不可排序区间，不能强制单个赢家。
5. **冻结数值。** 将源文值、旧真实结果、新增参考值和推断分列。新容差依据实验提取误差、数值收敛、方法/构象敏感性和等价路线参考确定；相对变化与绝对值分别校准。不得机械沿用旧端点的±阈值，更不得事后放宽到覆盖任意错误对象。

## 4. evaluator 的最低实现要求

实施时不必照抄以下文件名，但必须有同等可追溯关系：对象表、原始作业索引、主观测/控制差异表、假设–证据–结论表、资源记录、公开/私有数据清单。它们是出题方参考设计，不能把作者路线或赢家经这些文件泄露给AR。

验收顺序：

1. **身份与有效性**：守恒、原子映射、电子态、收敛、驻点/路径/周期模型符合要求。
2. **必需计算覆盖**：顶部核心矩阵中每一科学比较有真实结果，允许有证据的候选坍缩/排除，但不将一次不收敛当全空间不存在。
3. **可重算数值**：从引用的原始文件能重算关键量及差值，定义/单位一致，数值满足已冻结的参考范围。
4. **科学判断**：结论与干预及反例一致，指出仍无法区分的因素；不依赖照抄作者叙述获取高分。

发布前至少准备四类评分样例：完整有效结果；完成对照后得到合理否定/不可识别；只提交旧数值而缺新控制；错身份/错态/错能量零点。新框架必须拒绝后两类，不把格式分或“诚实失败”加到科学通过。可选扩展不计入首版硬失败。

AR/PR 使用同一个科学对象、观测定义、容差和完成判据。PR可暴露作者路线，AR保留独立研究选择。实际结果可证明同一科学问题可计算，但不能补造历史AR自主决策轨迹。

## 5. 软件范围与替代边界

以当前完整版 [chemistry_toolbox](../../../chemistry_toolbox/README.md)、[原生程序指南](../../../chemistry_toolbox/config/native_software_guides.yaml)、[运行时配置](../../../chemistry_toolbox/config/mcp_profiles.yaml) 为依据。原生入口缺少专用Action不等于软件不能算；软件存在也不等于具体新模型已验证。

| 科学工作 | 默认参考工具范围 | 需要额外校准的边界 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 分子基态/频率/热化学 | Gaussian或ORCA；CREST/xTB辅助初猜；GoodVibes可作统一热化学后处理 | xTB最低点/势垒不直接顶替目标DFT；不同程序的同名溶剂/色散/基组先核对 |
| TD、NMR、ECD、响应、EPR | Gaussian/ORCA原生功能，Multiwfn等分析已导出的波函数/密度 | NTO/态映射、核种/符号、响应张量、SOC与根窗口；功能存在不等于可靠方法 |
| TS/IRC/有限机制 | Gaussian/ORCA与pysisyphus；PyFrag仅在碎片及路径定义一致时使用 | 同一势面端点、守恒、局部/共同零点、标准态；扫描峰不是自动TS |
| 统计/连续模型 | 允许的Python/SciPy环境 | 必须有真实数据、物理模型和可识别性，不能拟合任意函数冒充机制 |
| 周期/表面/界面 | GPAW/QE/CP2K等已配置后端，ASE辅助 | 赝势、晶胞、磁态、表面/真空/k点及尺寸收敛按本题建立 |
| 多参考/能量分解/体相/输运 | 按单篇有条件启用ORCA/PySCF/Psi4/GROMACS等 | 活性空间、碎片、力场、电荷、采样和接口各有独立参考要求；NEGF仍在阻塞队列 |

首版不要求安装新商业软件。将NBO等许可或专门接口列为必需之前先核实实际可调用范围；替代分析需证明支持同一科学观测，不能静默更换量的定义。SIESTA的现有原生指南仅列siesta入口，不能由此推定完整偏压TBtrans链已允许且跑通。

## 6. 资源与每批完成条件

资源逐作业记录：实际科学引擎启动数、成功/失败/重启、分配CPU核数、有效计算小时、CPU核小时；有进程累计CPU时间则单独列。作业小时求和与并行日历跨度分列。多段Link1/多个扫描点未重新启动引擎时不分别计启动；后处理分析不算科学引擎调用。估算值必须标预计，参考完整跑完后才填实测。

批次不是必须整批成功后才能继续的硬依赖。某篇满足自身入口和资源条件可推进，另一篇阻塞则留在准备队列。每篇完成顺序为：数据和定义冻结 → 最关键控制试算 → 最低完整参考及稳健性 → 两模式任务/评分同步 → 无作者答案泄露的独立试运行 → 对照原始结果审查。未完成新增参考时，只能称“方案/参考开发中”，不能称“升级版验证通过”。

## 3. 科学边界与来源纠正

1. **苄醇：** Iₑ 与 Dₑ 均为约定的电子能差，不混入 ZPE/G，不把气相电离当绝对电极电位。单一 H 原子参考必须一致。检验预测可为数值或排序；已经看过结果时如实采用回顾检验，不能补造盲预测历史。
2. **环氧片段：** 作者方法段是 B3LYP-D3(BJ)，图注出现 CAM-B3LYP 的不一致已在 PR 中披露。以方法段为复现基线、其他层级单独列。分子偶极不等于树脂 Dk；对任意取向偶极向量求和不能代替 ⟨μ²⟩。
3. **并环戊搭烯：** NICS 使用完整张量对分子法向投影。源文正文和 SI 的响应基组不一致，PR 明确采用 SI 基线并披露差异。冻结骨架控制不能冒充自由极小值。
4. **锌配合物：** 对角 G 和交叉几何电子能分开；允许真实构象塌缩，不强造四个不同极小值。后 SCF D3 的同几何开关不能被解释成直接电子密度干预。红移与增强振子强度分开判断。
5. **铱硝酸根：** 从公开输入移出直接揭示 eta2 的旧 X-ray 参数，改为不固定金属—硝酸根连接的组成定义和未指派 IR。PR 将 eta2 作为作者假设提供。1532/1261/1223/802 与另含 1561 cm⁻¹ 的两套观测均需比较；源文没有明确通用数值缩放因子，不能冒称作者给定。
6. **发色团：** 补入 PQCZCS 的完整身份；其与 AQ 是同分异构体，不可混为一物；SI `[M+H]+` 分子式不作为中性计算式。AR 不预先提供特定分子的 CT/局域态赢家；PR 作者解释与新增共同扭角设计分开。

## 4. 科学评分和完成标准

科学评分总分为 100：对象/有效性 10，三项各篇特定研究端点合计 65，实际假设检验和定量稳健性 15，有证据的结论 10。新增对照、能量分解、系综或态匹配都进入评分，旧标量加一段机制文字不足以完成新版。

评分规则要求从原始文件核对定义、覆盖、数值相减、权重、张量投影、谱残差或态对应。对于拓展范围，现阶段使用有具体证据要求的条件/语义规则；**尚未伪造新的数值参考和容差**。源文数值及旧实际结果仅作为相同定义的基线参考；完整新增参考和方法敏感性建立后，才可冻结可接受数值范围。

计算支持作者、反驳作者，或完成充分对照后仍存在不可区分性，都可构成有效科学结论。少算一个必需端点、一次不收敛或没有执行对照，不等于完成了“不可识别性”研究。`bounded_failure` 可被提交格式接受，但不自动获得科学通过。

# ResearchChem three-layer chemistry toolbox

This directory is the canonical home of the composable chemistry toolbox.

The MCP surface has three peer execution layers:

1. all 101 predefined Scientific/Data Actions for validated common operations;
2. reviewed software-native commands for Agent-authored input decks when no Action fits;
3. Agent-authored Python programs in explicitly selected chemistry runtimes.

No layer selects a workflow, software, method, or scientific parameter for the
Agent, and there is no automatic fallback. See
[`docs/CHEMISTRY_TOOLBOX_THREE_LAYER_ARCHITECTURE.md`](docs/CHEMISTRY_TOOLBOX_THREE_LAYER_ARCHITECTURE.md)
for the complete execution and benchmark contract.

```text
chemistry_toolbox/
├── src/   protocol-independent Action and Backend core
├── mcp/                        FastMCP transport and Agent integration
├── config/                     versioned runtime, software, and resource manifests
├── environment/                reproducible environment specifications and locks
├── software_management/        managed software-cache installation and migration
├── native_software_docs/       generated, Agent-searchable native software manuals
├── evidence/                   versioned smoke and failure-replay evidence
├── scripts/                    setup, audit, smoke, and report commands
├── tests/                      chemistry-toolbox tests
├── examples/                   small analysis and native-integration examples
├── patches/                    reviewed upstream compatibility patches
└── docs/                       architecture, capability, and audit documentation
```

Run the focused toolbox regression suite with:

```bash
bash chemistry_toolbox/scripts/run_toolbox_tests.sh
```

`config/native_software_guides.yaml` is the versioned, machine-readable source
for exact native command syntax, input mode, required files, output behavior,
and examples. It is validated against BackendSpec executables and explicitly
configured runtime-only commands.

The pre-refactor repository-root implementations and compatibility links were
removed. Source code, configuration, scripts, tests, and documentation now have
one canonical location under this directory.

Large runtime assets remain outside the source tree:

- `../.software_cache`: installed scientific programs and local documentation
- `../.model_cache`: model weights
- `../.envs/researchchembench`: framework, development, and audit environment
- `../.envs/*`: seven consolidated backend runtime environments

The completed migration and verification record is available in
[`docs/CHEMISTRY_TOOLBOX_LAYOUT_REFACTOR_20260721.md`](docs/CHEMISTRY_TOOLBOX_LAYOUT_REFACTOR_20260721.md).
The complete 233-pair Action/Backend audit is available in
[`docs/ACTION_BACKEND_COMPLETE_AUDIT_20260721.md`](docs/ACTION_BACKEND_COMPLETE_AUDIT_20260721.md).
The follow-up repair and PubChem connectivity report is available in
[`docs/ACTION_BACKEND_REPAIR_REPORT_20260721.md`](docs/ACTION_BACKEND_REPAIR_REPORT_20260721.md).

Exact `linux-64` environment locks and the automatic migration/bootstrap
workflow are documented in
[`docs/CHEMISTRY_TOOLBOX_PORTABLE_BOOTSTRAP.md`](docs/CHEMISTRY_TOOLBOX_PORTABLE_BOOTSTRAP.md).

## 1. 当前任务在论文中的位置与分类

**当前为 A；最低升级建议为 B。** 任务已经要求自己构建 H₂ 进攻方式、找过渡态、确认虚频与两端连接，不能说它只是读入作者 TS 后做单点。但终点仍是指定硅烯 1 和 V′ 的同一种 H–H 活化能垒，验证对象和反应类型均已选定。尝试多个初猜不自动把科学目标变成 C。

论文研究的是六种六元环状烷基氨基硅烯的计算设计，涉及取代和稠环对电子结构的影响，以及 H₂、乙炔、氨硼烷和 CO₂ 等反应。当前题仅覆盖其中一项两体系比较，尚未触及“怎样的结构改造、通过什么原因改善反应性”的主要设计问题。正文给出 1–6 的 H₂ 活化能垒约为 32.9、30.4、31.2、29.0、27.8、28.6 kcal/mol；V′ 约为 47.4 kcal/mol。[正文 PDF p4](../../../papers/paper_0e835b370ddd37b6/documents/main.pdf#page=4) [正文 PDF p5](../../../papers/paper_0e835b370ddd37b6/documents/main.pdf#page=5)

V′ 是源研究中的截短比较模型，不能拿不同大小模型的总能直接比较稳定性。公开 1/V′ 输入分别为 55/36 原子，另有 H₂；早期错误对象不属于本次依据。两模式当前比较的是相同的科学量：苯溶剂、298 K、1 atm，以分离硅烯和 H₂ 为零点的 Gibbs 活化能。

## 4. 最低 B 方案：电子作用还是几何形变决定活化差异

建议提出的问题是：**在原文有限硅烯集合中，哪些受控计算支持“电子结构调节降低 H₂ 活化难度”，哪些差异主要来自接近和形变代价？** 最低集合明确为 **1、V′、4**。正文说明 4 将 1 中邻氨基的四配位碳位置改为羰基，因此用 1/4 形成有源文依据的结构对照，V′ 保留为已验证锚点。先做原子映射与结构核对，不因其他体系源文能垒更低就事后换对照。[正文 PDF p4](../../../papers/paper_0e835b370ddd37b6/documents/main.pdf#page=4)

| 竞争解释 | 需要的干预/对照 | 有支持力的证据 | 可否证情形 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 电子给出/接受能力是主要因素 | 同一 H–H 延伸程度下比较电子重排；对一对结构做固定几何与弛豫计算 | 同方向电荷重排和相互作用改变，且不完全由形变能解释 | 换相近几何后电子优势消失，或描述符排序与可靠能垒相反 |
| 位阻/骨架形变代价主导 | 沿同一反应坐标拆开反应物形变与相互作用，并保留片段电子态 | 主要能量差来自到达 TS 区域的形变代价 | 形变代价接近，而相互作用差解释了能垒差 |
| 现有排序依赖构象或方法 | 独立构象、另一合理泛函、同一标准态和热化学控制 | 结论在误差范围外保持，或诚实收窄为不能判别 | 排序随合理模型改变且差值不超过不确定性 |

不要强求某一种解释必须获胜；评价应看干预是否区分了这些解释。

## 5. 必需计算工作包与中间量

1. **身份和基线。** 核对 1、V′、追加结构与 SI 的骨架、取代、电荷、自旋；分别建立最低点、H₂ 和至少一个有效 H₂ 活化 TS。保留每种初猜的来源、收敛状态与去重理由。输出同一反应零点的 E、热修正和 G。
2. **最小构象覆盖。** 在 Si 邻域/取代基有柔性时生成有区别的进攻姿态，先筛选再做统一 DFT；检查得到的是同一反应而非骨架重排。一个低能 TS 只有在搜索范围明确时才可作该范围代表，不能宣称全局唯一。
3. **路径与能量分解。** 对保留 TS 做两端连接；沿相同 H–H 距离抽取少量可比点。以“中性硅烯＋中性 H₂”固定片段边界，计算各片段在复合体几何与自身平衡几何下的电子能，得到形变/相互作用的操作性分解。分片必须与已声明自旋和电子数一致。
4. **电子证据。** 在相同几何和统一布居方法下比较密度差、Si/H 原子或片段电荷、成键指标及必要轨道图。若 NBO 授权/接口未确认，用可重复的 Multiwfn 分析并明确不是源 NBO 数值；不强制不可用的专有分解。
5. **稳健性与判别。** 先用关键点单点检验另一泛函，再在差异可能改变结论时补优化/频率。分别报告电子能、热修正、溶剂和标准态影响；给出每种假设得到/失去支持的具体证据。

以上为科学工作包，不是“5 次计算”。实际启动计数需从新增作业记录取得；一个工作包可含多个引擎启动，单个 IRC/扫描启动也可含许多点。

## 6. 建议题面、输入及 evaluator

可用题面：**“在给定硅烯骨架和限定溶剂条件下，比较 H₂ 活化，并设计最小对照判断反应性差异主要与电子相互作用还是形变有关。提交能垒、有效反应连接和可否证的结构—反应性解释。”**

AR 公开结构身份、允许改变的单一位置、物理边界和预算，不公开获胜结构、作者 TS、论文能垒和机制归因；PR 可给作者结构和方法指导，终点相同。实验/论文信息供维护者建参考，不把本方案或私有结果挂入 agent 输入。

拟议评分至少覆盖：对象/态正确；可比较且连通的反应路径；统一定义的能垒；真正执行的几何/电子控制；依据控制选择或否定解释。每项必须链接输出；只有描述符、没有对照，不能获得“已解释原因”的分。数值容差由新增参考的重复性和模型波动校准，不直接沿用旧两个能垒的容差覆盖所有新量。

## 7. 工具可行性、资源与发布前条件

**有条件可行。** Gaussian/ORCA 已有同类真实 TS、频率与路径证据；RDKit/CREST/xTB 可作初猜和筛选，最终不得把低层路径当作 DFT 验证。Multiwfn 和原生单点可以完成最低分析；PyFrag 仅在分片定义和所需后端通过小体系试算后使用，不作为唯一验收依赖。

旧参考累计有效作业 elapsed 约 **108.1703 小时**，日志原生 CPU 时间约 **2107.0105 小时**；二者不是并行日历总跨度。扩大构象、增加结构和干预后不可承诺同样预算。先试算一个新增结构的基态和一个 TS，再据实际核数、内存、单次耗时和重启率制定预算，新增 CPU 核小时与墙钟目前均待测。

发布前必须完成：新增结构身份映射；至少一个受控结构对照的参考计算；同坐标分解的稳定性检查；盲输入到结果的有限试跑。若新增 TS 不可重复或各模型相反，保留真实负结果并缩小结论，不把更低层的预期数值填入参考。

## 8. 可选 C 扩展与边界

参考 B 闭合后，可限定原文 1–6 的改造规则，让 agent 自主生成少量候选，寻找“降低活化代价且不过度稳定加成产物”的折中。必须预先固定可编辑位点、价态、候选上限和独立验证预算，并保留未选候选证据。这才形成有限结构发现任务。最低版本不要求解决 CO₂ 全还原或整个氨硼烷脱氢循环，相关新通道必须另做参考验证。

## 4. 最低 B 问题：低成键能垒是否足以保证末端再生

建议问题：**在完整 INT-G 模型内，末端再生主要受到 H–H 成键、H₂ 解离还是 Pd 构象/配位变化限制？结论对标准态、H₂ 化学势和合理构象是否稳健？**

| 竞争解释 | 实际控制 | 需要看到的证据 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 还原消除后可直接再生 | 连续追踪 TS→结合 H₂→分离 Pd/H₂ | 完整原子守恒链与沿途能量，不只一个 TS |
| 结合 H₂ 或配位重排构成后续瓶颈 | 从不同 H₂ 接近/离去取向和 Pd 构象检查释放路径 | 是否存在新的局部滞留或额外上坡，不把连续扫描最大值自动当无约束 TS |
| 小反应自由能主要受环境定义控制 | 清楚区分源 1 atm、统一 1 M 诊断与实际气体 H₂ 化学势 | 条件相容的自由能曲线与敏感性，不能用单位转换伪装新的化学机制 |
| 旧低能垒来自局部构象/方法 | 有限构象与另一合理能量模型控制 | 能垒和释放趋势是否在不确定性范围外成立 |

## 5. 具体计算工作包

1. **基线账本。** 从原始几何/低层频率/高层单点重建组合 G，显式写 G_composite = E_high + (G_low−E_low)。原子、配体、H 两原子映射一致，禁止把高层 E 与另一几何的 G_low 拼接。
2. **有限前体和终态构象。** 对 INT-G、结合 H₂ 及无 H₂ 的 Pd 片段检查少量与配体排列相关的初态；相同连接去重。低层筛选后需要 DFT 验证，不能让端点丢配体却当成同一再生过程。
3. **TS 与两端连接。** 在统一主协议下保留正确成键虚频，双向路径后优化最低点；失败前缀仅在其结构/能量被接受且后续另有端点证据时使用。
4. **H₂ 释放。** 以明确 Pd—H₂ 距离/方向做连续释放诊断，保留每点约束与自由坐标收敛；另算真正分离的 Pd 和 H₂。若发现额外能量最大值，补相应路径/驻点检查，不能仅因扫描有高点就宣称找到了新的鞍点。
5. **物理条件。** 先复现源标准态，再选择一个明确的溶液溶质标准态与 H₂ 分压假设，用合适的化学势换算进行条件敏感性。全溶质 1 M 仅是诊断，不代表真实逸出气体条件；若缺逸出/溶解模型，不预测实验 H₂ 速率。
6. **机制判断。** 对“成键容易”与“整个末端再生容易”分别给结论，用能量、端点和条件依赖逐项支撑。不能以 0.764 小能垒推断整循环周转速率。

## 6. 建议题面和 evaluator

可用题面：**“判断指定 Pd 二氢化物的末端 H₂ 消除及释放是否能支持催化剂再生，并通过路径和环境控制查找该推断的限制条件。”** 公开反应物、完整模型、温度/溶剂和允许的条件区间，私有保留作者 TS、释放参考及数值。

评价要求：同对象组合能正确；真实 H–H TS 与连接；结合/分离产物区分；一组实际释放/构象控制；条件一致的自由能推论。标准态说明本身不单独给机制分，必须有对应数值与结论变化。新的释放判据须由新增参考校准，不能把旧 0.9±2 当作整个末端过程的标准。

## 7. 可行性、资源及 C 扩展条件

**有条件可行。** Gaussian/ORCA 能完成基态、频率、复合能和反应路径，已有完整大模型实例。关键条件是释放曲线可靠、不同端点计量相同、气体/溶液化学势定义清楚；这些比程序是否安装更决定正确性。

先复用可追溯基线并补一个替代构象和释放控制，测实际每次科学引擎启动、核数和小时，再决定是否扩大。旧计算 56.0244 小时是累计 elapsed，不是独立新任务的固定墙钟。

更接近整篇机制发现的 C 可限定“含硅自由基生成与直接 Pd SET 哪条路径更可行”，结合 SI pp11–12 的竞争机理建立新参考。该模块涉及激发态、自旋变化与后续断裂；不能直接把单重态基态 TS 工具的成功当作完整光化学路径能力证明。参考未闭合前不加入最低 B 评分。

## 1. 改造结论与科学范围

**建议结论。** 比较[TMTFABA]OTf、[PTMA]OTf、TFAP及计量匹配的物理混合对照，区分电子极化和离子对/氢键预组织对环氧化及CO2环加成的作用。

论文的整体研究主线是：双官能团离子液体使烯烃环氧化与 CO₂ 环加成在兼容条件下高效串联；核心主张是两活性位点相互促进。 本方案截取其中能够通过明确计算和证据比较完成的科学子问题，不要求重演论文全部合成、表征和应用实验。

**本次边界。** 以苯乙烯和相应环氧化物为代表，两个阶段分别定义参考态及实际添加剂；最小B只检验预定义关键步骤，不要求完整自由路径搜索。

**为什么达到B。** agent需要区分下列竞争解释，自主选择有区分力的控制计算，并判断多种观测是否支持同一种解释；研究范围限定不妨碍其作为自主科研题。 评分必须检查控制模型是否改变了待检验因素、结果是否支持或否定解释。只加一个hypotheses字段或增加几次单点计算不构成升级。

**计算量及科学量的定义。** 主量为ΔΔG‡与相互作用差异，电荷为辅助；保持自由能参考计量相等，量化两步是否同向受益。

**可靠性要求。** 优化结果核实连接性和收敛；自由极小值要有频率或等价Hessian证据，约束扫描点不得冒充自由极小值。候选改变电荷、自旋或粒子数时，先补齐反应计量与参考库，再比较能量。统一溶剂、温度、标准态、热校正与相对能量零点；涉及柔性系综时保留去重、简并度及权重约定。不同人口分析、片段分解或光谱处理约定须明确；改变分析定义后的量不得直接套用另一约定的参考数。

**停止依据。** 完成预先限定对象及必要对照，对最影响结论的一个方法或采样因素作稳健性检验；新候选不再改变主要排序／解释且覆盖标准满足后停止。若关键证据缺失，报告具体缺口与下一项最有区分力的计算，不能把搜索预算耗尽写成“已证明不存在替代解释”。

上述权重合计100分，属于设计建议。需要同时记录 **计算有效性、推理／发现过程得分、科学目标完成状态**；不得让格式分或诚实失败的过程分抵消缺少核心计算。最终通过阈值及关键点最低要求应在发布前用已验证样例校准并固定，不在本方案中虚构已实测的阈值。

### 8.2 最终结论如何验收

必须逐一回答H1–H3对应的科学争议，明确支持、反对或未能区分的证据。完成范围至少涵盖K1–K6所列核心观测及对照；最终结论应能由这些中间量推出。不能只把论文的排序或描述符复述为因果结论。

evaluator要从原始证据检查“同一对象→同一观测定义→可复核中间量→合理比较→结论”的链条。若原文支持多个相容解释，应在参考结论中预先登记可接受等价答案及适用条件；发现新解释而没有完成原先必须给出的量时，只给相应过程分，不能自动宣告目标通过。

### 8.3 数值容差与不确定性

对每步预测方向与观察对应等主要区分性量，先由统一方法参考解和一次合理方法／采样扰动建立可接受区间。若竞争解释间差异小于该区间，应保留未定结论；不用强制排序制造区分力。

容差需区分实验测量误差、图像数字化误差、数值收敛误差和方法／模型差异。不能把原任务的一个经验容差复制给不同对象、单位或参考态。图中读取的值标记为digitized，保留采样点和图像坐标；无原始重复测量时不得虚构标准差。统一拟合参数应在公开训练部分确定，随后冻结用于保留观测。

### 8.4 应判为未完成或重大错误的情形

- 只复算旧任务终值，缺少本方案的竞争解释和关键对照。
- 正文/SI的H2O2计量等表述需回到实际条件核对；不能把不同浓度或阴离子的比较称严格单变量实验。
- 缺失两组ΔG‡及连通证据，却仍宣告完成整个科学目标。

共同底线包括：伪造原始输出；改变对象身份却沿用原ID；只展示最接近答案的成功候选；将未收敛或错误电子态用于决定结论；使用隐藏参考作为计算结果；关键对照没有实际计算。技术性失败可以有过程得分，但目标完成状态须为未完成。

**目标。** 在论文一个明确底物上检验取代效应是否改变 SET 与能量转移的可行条件。

## 5. 竞争解释与可证伪判断

1. H1：激发态氧化还原能力随取代改变并支持 SET。

这些是出题方用于验证任务设计的候选解释，不应全部连同结果预先公开给 AR agent。正式题允许 agent 提出等价、可检验的解释；关键是有计算能改变其判断，而不是只在报告里写“存在若干假设”。

**为何值得升级/加强。** 保留现有科学问题的价值，补足区分解释、发现候选或检验预测所需的证据。难度上升本身不是科学能力升级。

**边界。** 不要求在本轮首版完成全部光化学非绝热轨迹，也不把基态最低产物称为唯一光产物。

1. H1：几何接近且连续可达的顺序环化解释选择性。
2. H2：截止外构象/竞争闭环同样可达，端点能排序不足。

## 4. 加强 C 的核心问题与最小设计

问题：**在原文允许的两种系链中，自主找出可达的竞争环化路径，判断改变链长是否足以切换优势通道；溶剂或构象是否能产生同等重要的影响？**

最低矩阵为 **2 个链长 × 2 个溶剂（DMSO、DCE）× 2 个化学通道**。这是 8 组“体系—通道”组合，不是 8 次引擎启动，也不是保证只有 8 个 TS。每个体系有自己的自由基参考；不同组成/溶剂之间比较的是通道差和干预响应，不比较绝对总能。

| 假设 | 判别设计 | 支持/反驳条件 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 增长链长引入七元成环形变，从而切换通道 | 在同一溶剂比较两链长；同一成键距离下比较几何形变与能量响应 | 若链长效应跨溶剂保持且由形变证据支持，得到支持；否则收窄 |

| 少量 TS 构象造成假反转 | 独立初猜、不同折叠/接近方式及去重 | 找到更低替代通道时必须更新排序，不能只留作者式 TS |
| 源图的小差值并不稳健 | 关键 TS 的另一方法/低频控制 | 若 0.52 的符号不能稳定确定，报告近竞争而非伪精确胜者 |

3. **分层搜索。** 用低层方法筛选构象/接近路径，再在统一 DFT 层优化 TS 和参考自由基。低层排序仅引导搜索；最终不能用 xTB 路径加一个 DFT 单点冒充 DFT 反应路径。
4. **真实路径。** 每个保留 TS 要有一条相关虚频并通过双向 IRC 或可审查的模式跟随和端点优化确定反应连接。出现第三类重排如实记录，不把非目标成键当成功环化。
5. **热力学账本。** 同体系两个通道使用相同参考/温度/标准态；报告电子能、热修正、G 和差值。前体构象影响要通过一致的参考或有证据的平衡加权处理，不能一边用最低前体一边重复加入布居因子。
6. **原因分析。** 在同一分子、相同成键程度下比较环/系链形变和电子重排；任意切断不同键的碎片分解不具唯一可比性，不作为硬证据。保留匹配坐标下的受限几何标签。
7. **结论稳健性。** 对长链小差值优先试另一合理方法、低频控制与关键构象补充；形成“稳健短链排序/长链近竞争或可复现反转”的分层结论。

## 6. 新评价设计

公开两种链长的图结构、介质边界和有限搜索预算；私有保留作者渠道身份、TS 和参考差值。AR 应以自主候选和有证据的选择为主；PR 可暴露作者路线，但物种、方法允许范围和最终科学终点一致。

必需评价：候选化学覆盖；有效 TS/端点；四种体系的统一参考差；真正完成的链长/溶剂交叉控制；对小能差的不确定性处理；据证据解释通道竞争。每项必须能追溯到独立输出。未完成必需体系不能用“模型不确定”得全分；完成后发现作者反转不稳健，应当作为合法科学结论，不能只因方向不符扣成失败。

若增加新链长或取代的盲留出 C 子题，先在私有参考中跑通该有限范围。初轮不加入全部底物、光催化剂激发、Zn 盐微观配位和后续氧化芳构化，更不从单步 ΔΔG‡ 直接要求精确产率。

## 7. 可行性、资源与优先验证

**有条件可行。** 短链真实 DFT 支持该类自由基和 TS 的技术可行性；RDKit、CREST/xTB、Gaussian/ORCA 和路径工具可组成流程。仍需验证长链 TS、交叉溶剂控制和从独立初态的可达性，软件存在不能替这些步骤保证成功。

优先顺序是：先用现行独立 starter 闭合短链两通道及路径；再做长链原介质；最后完成两个交叉溶剂。若长链能差易翻转，以成对路径的稳健性分析为科学终点，不通过选构象强行制造反转。新增作业数、CPU 核小时和并行墙钟待先导测量，不按旧 3 份输出线性推算。

### paper_3235db287859287e 
 # Scientific objective

Determine, for the explicitly defined neutral 3aa molecule, the 298 K Gibbs free-energy difference ΔG(E) − ΔG(Z) between its Z and E alkene stereoisomers, identify the lower-free-energy stereoisomer, and test whether each optimized structure is a valid minimum. The authors qualitatively propose that steric congestion favors one alkene arrangement; independently test this hypothesis.

# Author-provided scientific guidance

**Author hypothesis or claim.**
The authors propose that steric congestion differs between the two alkene arrangements and that reduced congestion can favor one stereoisomer thermodynamically, providing a possible explanation for the observed stereochemical preference.

**Candidate route or mechanism.**
Compare the two neutral 3aa alkene configurations as competing stationary-point structures, allowing geometries and conformations to relax under a common computational model. The proposed explanation concerns relative stability from substituent arrangement around the alkene, rather than a reaction pathway or electrochemical mechanism.

**Discriminating evidence.**
Use a common electronic-structure protocol with consistent solvent and thermal treatment, then assess optimized connectivity and E/Z assignment, vibrational confirmation of minima, conformer/search coverage, and the signed Gibbs free-energy comparison at 298 K.

# Public inputs and scientific boundaries

Use `data/inputs/3aa_stereoisomers.json`. It defines methyl 3-phenyl-2-((phenylsulfinyl)methyl)acrylate (formula C17H16O3S), charge 0, multiplicity 1, and authoritative isomeric SMILES and configuration labels for objects `3aa_Z` and `3aa_E`. The research object is only these two molecular stereoisomers. The measured quantity is their signed relative Gibbs free energy at a declared temperature and standard-state convention, in kcal/mol. Do not report reaction yield, electrochemical potential, rate, or a full mechanism.

# Required scientific validation/investigation

Generate and optimize at least one structure for each named object, choosing and briefly justifying a defensible common computational protocol. Verify connectivity and assigned E/Z geometry after optimization; perform vibrational analysis and report that each accepted structure has zero imaginary frequencies. Use the same charge, multiplicity, solvent treatment, temperature, and energy convention for both. If multiple conformers are explored, deduplicate them by structural identity and state how many were searched and how the retained conformer was selected. Scientific completion requires all requested primary observables, the specified validation evidence and the resulting scientific comparison. A partial or failed calculation may be submitted with its actual results and diagnostics, but does not satisfy an uncomputed scientific result. Interpret any preference only within this model boundary.

# Deliverables

Write `report/results.json` conforming to the submission schema. ### paper_2f0a4f80a37fbccd agent_input/task.md 
 # Scientific objective

Determine which nitrate coordination models of neutral singlet IrCl2(NO3)(PPh3)2 are supported by molecular stability and the supplied experimental IR observations. Test monodentate and bidentate candidates of the same composition, including necessary ligand-geometric alternatives, and determine whether the available evidence uniquely identifies a model.

# Public inputs and scientific boundaries

All supplied molecular/data files named below are in `data/inputs/`.

`complex_specification.json` fixes formula C36H30Cl2IrNO3P2, charge 0, multiplicity 1, two intact PPh3 ligands, two chlorides and one nitrate. Nitrate oxygen-to-metal connectivity is an investigated variable, not a supplied answer. Map Ir1/Cl1/Cl2/P1/P2/N1/O1/O2/O3 consistently. Generate full-composition eta1 and eta2 initial structures; do not turn a comparison into ligand dissociation, a nitrosyl complex or a smaller phosphine model.

`experimental_ir.json` provides unassigned KBr frequencies in cm−1. Four observations (1532, 1261, 1223, 802) are common to the reported experimental list; a further 1561 band occurs in the tabulated/discussion account. Assess the comparison with and without that additional observation. Neither a solved crystal connectivity nor computed frequencies are public inputs. The primary computational object is an isolated molecule; KBr solid-state shifts and intensities require an explicit uncertainty discussion.

Choose and record a consistent functional, basis/ECP and relativistic convention appropriate to Ir. Predeclare the spectral window, frequency-scaling policy and assignment/residual procedure before choosing a winning candidate; do not independently fit one scale factor per peak or choose it to favor one candidate. Quantify normal-mode nitrate participation and PPh3 mixing with a documented mass/displacement convention. Give Ir–O/N–O distances and nitrate/metal angles from optimized coordinates. Geometry and energy are corroborating evidence; scalar peak proximity alone is insufficient.

This is an autonomous-research task. Use the authorized public objects to formulate and test explanations independently. Do not read hidden evaluator files, private reference calculations, historical verification archives, the target paper or its SI, or import their answer structures, rankings or numerical targets. This task is self-contained; given input structures and explicitly stated measurements are authorized. General scientific/software documentation may be used without searching for target-paper answers.

# Required scientific validation/investigation

Generate eta1 and eta2 initial candidates plus relevant relative chloride/phosphine arrangements, with the atom map and candidate rationale. Optimize and calculate frequencies for distinct retained candidates. For a class that collapses, examine independent sensible initial geometries and record the actual trajectories/endpoints; one failure cannot establish global nonexistence.

Identify final coordination from actual distances/connectivity and inspect stationary-point validity. Preserve full composition throughout. Compare relative electronic energies, with thermal quantities separately defined if used; do not describe a gas-phase energy preference as a measured solid-phase population.

Calculate IR frequencies, intensities and displacement-based mode character. Apply one reproducible assignment/scaling procedure to all candidates, reporting assigned and unmatched observations, residuals and how nitrate/PPh3 mixing affects attribution. Compare both the common four-band set and the 1561-band-inclusive set as a required source-discrepancy sensitivity.

Use a decisive method, scaling or conformer sensitivity to challenge the preferred model. Decide whether structure, stability and vibrational evidence jointly distinguish eta1 from eta2, or leave a supported candidate set. A fully computed ambiguity is acceptable; a missing candidate calculation or speculative failure is not an ambiguity result. The entire oxygen/NO formation mechanism and crystal packing are outside scope.

Use genuine calculations for each required result. Preserve the distinction among free minima, constrained diagnostics, single-point evaluations, collapsed searches and failed jobs. A minimum requires frequencies or an explicitly justified equivalent establishing stationarity and positive curvature in all internal directions; optimization convergence alone is insufficient. Report any imaginary frequencies actually computed and justify unresolved numerical modes with additional evidence. Do not fabricate a frequency count for an equivalent validation route.

# Deliverables

Submit `report/results.json` conforming to `submission_schema.json` and a readable `report/report.md`. The report must connect the scientific question, competing explanations, actual interventions, numerical evidence and conclusion. Link raw engine logs, geometries, mode/state evidence and analysis code using workspace-relative `outputs/`, `data/` or `code/` paths. Use unique calculation `record_id` values and refer to those IDs consistently; retain software job IDs when provided by the execution tools.

The JSON `results` object has the following required panels:

- `candidates`: Same-composition eta1/eta2 initial and final structures, modes and relative energies.
- `mode_assignments`: Frequency/intensity and nitrate/PPh3 displacement participation for candidate modes.
- `spectral_comparison`: Uniform residual comparison with/without the additional 1561 cm−1 band.

Also record `methods`, `calculation_records`, at least two evidence-assessed `hypotheses`, actual quantitative `sensitivity` comparisons, and `conclusion`. Consult `submission_guide.md` for record conventions. Cite all relevant raw evidence in the readable report, not only JSON.

`status: "complete"` requires the expanded scientific endpoints, including the real controls. It does not require a preselected winner: an evidence-backed contradiction or ambiguity can complete the task. `status: "bounded_failure"` permits honest early/partial results with attempted calculations, diagnostics and missing endpoints. It does not turn uncomputed results into a scientific pass. Report optional work separately; optional extensions are not required for credit.


### paper_2f0a4f80a37fbccd agent_input/submission_guide.md 
 # Submission conventions

The JSON Schema is the exact field contract. This guide explains the scientific meaning.

- `methods.primary` states software/version, functional, basis/ECP, solvent and numerical settings. `methods.sensitivity` identifies actual alternative protocols. Use `method_key` to associate every record with the correct named protocol; explain additional names in the report.
- A `calculation_record` identifies an actual engine result with a unique ID, job ID, log path, molecular identity, state and environment. `energies.electronic_Eh` is the electronic energy. `thermal_G_correction_Eh`, if given, is **G minus electronic E**, including ZPE: therefore G = E + thermal_G_correction, not E + ZPE + thermal_G_correction. Record ZPE separately for audit. Cross points have no invented equilibrium G.
- A single engine job can support several quantities; reference the same record. Separately launched jobs have distinct IDs even if they converge to the same geometry. Deduplicate physical minima, not the history of attempted jobs. If no tool job ID exists, record the actual execution identifier and log location.
- Arrays of `evidence_files` point to actual workspace files in `outputs/`, `data/` or `code/`. They are provenance, not declarations of correctness. Every cited record, geometry, normal-mode or NTO file must exist and correspond to the reported method. JSON validity alone does not verify this.
- All angles are degrees, geometry distances angstrom, electronic energies hartree; panel names specify other units. State comparisons use **right minus left** for energy and oscillator-strength deltas; report the state-matching metric and its definition. Character metrics must give normalization and fragment definitions. Quantitative character is needed for every state used in an inference; the full root window still includes energy/f for dark and unused roots.
- `hypotheses` records distinguishable propositions, an observation that tests each, actual supporting/contradicting records and the resulting assessment. A hypothesis statement without a calculation is not evidence.
- `sensitivity` compares actual baseline and alternative quantities: `change = alternative_value - baseline_value`. Reusing primary results without a changed, justified factor is not a sensitivity test.
- A `bounded_failure` may omit uncomputed panels, hypotheses and sensitivity results; provide actual attempt records, available partial results, failure evidence and missing endpoints. Failed records may omit energy and geometry rather than fabricate them. No numerical minimum or endpoint is implied by format acceptance.

# Required result panels

## `candidates`

Same-composition eta1/eta2 initial and final structures, modes and relative energies.

## `mode_assignments`

Frequency/intensity and nitrate/PPh3 displacement participation for candidate modes.

## `spectral_comparison`

Uniform residual comparison with/without the additional 1561 cm−1 band.

## 科学范围与来源

铱硝酸根：竞争配位模型与振动谱判别。首版 B 类：Determine which nitrate coordination models of neutral singlet IrCl2(NO3)(PPh3)2 are supported by molecular stability and the supplied experimental IR observations. Test monodentate and bidentate candidates of the same composition, including necessary ligand-geometric alternatives, and determine whether the available evidence uniquely identifies a model.

- [main.pdf](../../../../../papers/paper_2f0a4f80a37fbccd/documents/main.pdf), SHA256 `76fe828053d735014dabbbcf20749bb2d180992ed7921df2190fc89bacca8438`, PDF 页码 3, 4, 7, 8。

来源核对：Main PDF pp3–4 structure and IR/Table2; p8 experimental characterization. Source favors eta2. The old public X-ray geometry is now private to avoid revealing the structural answer: Ir–O 2.173/2.174 Å and O–Ir–O 60.02 degrees are corroborating source measurements, not new computed tolerances. The 1561 cm−1 entry is tabulated/discussed but absent from the p8 experimental list. New eta1/eta2 discrimination and matched residuals have not been reference-computed.

## 可用工具与先导

Gaussian/ORCA Opt/Freq，适当的 Ir ECP/相对论处理；Python 做可重算的模式参与度和谱残差。

源 B3LYP/LANL2DZ 母体及正常模解析复核后，试同组成 eta1/eta2 初猜；校准频率缩放与残差，再判断实验能否区分。

工具已经安装不等于此对象、方法或新增矩阵已被验证。必须记录真实命令/作业次数、单作业核数、墙钟小时和 CPU 核时；本次开发没有运行新的科学引擎，不填写臆测耗时或宣称全范围可通过。

## 逐项建立数值参考

### `candidates`

Same-composition eta1/eta2 initial and final structures, modes and relative energies.

检查重点：Verify full ligands, electron state, initial/final coordination and valid minima. Supported collapse must include independent attempts; do not infer global absence from a numerical failure.

### `mode_assignments`

Frequency/intensity and nitrate/PPh3 displacement participation for candidate modes.

检查重点：Reconstruct nitrate assignments from actual vectors, not labels or nearest frequency. Verify a single scaling convention and geometry-derived Ir/O/N observables.

### `spectral_comparison`

Uniform residual comparison with/without the additional 1561 cm−1 band.

检查重点：Check the full four-band evidence and the source-list discrepancy sensitivity, unmatched peaks and solid/gas limits. Full credit permits an evidence-backed candidate set rather than requiring the paper winner by assertion.

## 校准与独立验收

1. 按公开边界和 PR 作者基线完成必要真实计算，保留 inputs、引擎输出、结构、波函数/模式/态文件及解析代码。逐个核实组成、态、原子/片段映射、收敛与最低点/约束点身份。
2. 从原始输出独立重算能量差、权重、张量投影、光谱对比或态匹配；为每个扩展 panel 建立机器可读取参考，不能把旧单点结果复制成新增对照。
3. 量化对数值收敛、构象/低频、理论水平和可接受替代方法的敏感性。只有这些真实证据建立后才能填写物理容差、等价实现及允许的未决结论。当前 evaluator 以科学条件和原始证据为规则，未伪造新数值靶值。
4. 用同一公开研究范围试运行 AR 和 PR；检查 PR 能复现作者基线且开展新增对照，AR 不依赖隐藏论文答案。两模式的科学结果评分相同，研究过程可因提供作者路线而不同。
5. 加入反例：只提交旧任务结果、换错分子/电子态、遗漏对照、混淆能量定义、捏造不存在的稳定构象、复制目标数值无日志。应在相应科学项失分；完整且有证据的反驳或歧义应被接受。
6. 依据真实先导成本设置预算；超预算先审查科学范围或方法等价性，不降低对象身份或偷偷替换结果。证据不足时保留 pending 状态。

Encoding eta2 as a fixed answer, removing or replacing ligands, fitting peak-specific scales, inventing nitrate mode character without vectors, or using one failed eta1 optimization to prove no eta1 basin exists.

Density functional theory (DFT) calculations were carried out using the Gaussian 09 program.

Main-group atoms were described using the 6-31G (for C, H) and 6-311G** (for O, S) basis

sets. For iodine, the aug-cc-pVDZ-PP relativistic pseudopotential basis set was used, with

parameters obtained from the Basis Set Exchange (BSE). The corresponding pseudopotential

references (Peterson et al. 2003, 2006) and database references (Pritchard et al. 2019; Feller

1996; Schuchardt 2007) are cited accordingly.[4-8] All reported free energies include thermal

corrections at 298 K. Solvation effects (MeCN) were computed using the SMD implicit solvent

model. All stationary points were characterized by vibrational analysis: Minima exhibit no

imaginary frequencies. Transition states (TS) exhibit a single imaginary frequency, and were

validated by IRC calculations connecting reactant and product minima. Thermal corrections to

Gibbs free energies (ΔG) were obtained at 298 K and 1 atm.



11. Iodide-Assisted Hydrogen Relay (II′ → III–HI)

To examine the feasibility of the proton/hydrogen shift between the hydroxyl group and iodide,

a relaxed potential energy surface (PES) scan was performed along the O–H⋯I coordinate

using the modredundant opt scan protocol. The scan was carried out by incrementally

elongating the O–H distance while allowing all other internal coordinates to relax.



Results: The PES shows a smooth, monotonic increase from II′ to III–HI. No first-order saddle

point was detected anywhere along the coordinate. The total barrier along the scan is only 6.8

kcal mol⁻¹, distributed over several small increments (1.9 → 1.7 → 1.6 → 1.4 → 1.3 kcal mol⁻¹).

These results indicate that the hydrogen relay occurs on a flat PES without a resolvable

transition state, consistent with an iodide-mediated H-shuttle rather than a discrete proton-

transfer TS.

The authors propose that the three diamines share a common nucleophilic reactivity ordering toward TMC. They interpret local ionization based descriptors as the primary indicators, with electrostatic potential as complementary evidence.

**Candidate route or mechanism.**
The proposed comparison is direct amine attack at the TMC acyl chloride functionality, assessed through the electronic properties of the diamine nitrogen sites. The authors consider a multi-descriptor interpretation combining average local ionization energy or a related nucleophilicity index with electrostatic potential, frontier orbital information, and the conformational state of each diamine.

**Discriminating evidence.**
Compute and compare nitrogen mapped local descriptors, including local ionization or nucleophilicity measures and electrostatic potential, together with frontier orbital indicators where feasible. Use optimized isolated-molecule geometries and the specified inter-benzene dihedral definition; assess equivalent amine sites and conformational or method sensitivity to determine whether the descriptors support or conflict with the proposed ordering.

# Public inputs and scientific boundaries

Use `data/inputs/monomers.json` for the neutral singlet identities and atom-mapped graphs of ODA, 6FODA, PFMB and TMC, and `data/inputs/observable_definitions.json` for the measurement conventions. Generate conformers independently. Preserve connectivity/protonation; the two fluorinated diamines each have two CF3 groups. The comparison is isolated gas-phase diamines; TMC is the reaction-context partner, not a fourth member of their ranking. TMC optimization and a TMC inter-ring angle are not required.

The primary global index is `N_global = HOMO(diamine) - HOMO(TCE)`, in eV, using the declared fixed TCE reference of -9.1212 eV and comparable B3LYP/def2-TZVP HOMOs on B3LYP-D3BJ/def2-SVP stationary geometries. This is a common measurement scale, not a supplied molecular result or ranking. Other methods may inform exploration/sensitivity but must be reported separately. A local descriptor is a separate observable and cannot replace this index. Vertical charged electron-removal/addition probes are permitted for local descriptors at the neutral geometry; they do not change the neutral-singlet target identity.

Use only the public files and allowed tools, not paper/SI documents, web searches, optimized author coordinates, reference values or evaluator conclusions. Do not extrapolate this isolated-molecule comparison to computed membrane performance, solvent effects or experimental kinetic constants.

# Required scientific validation/investigation

Construct a finite, deduplicated conformer set for each diamine (or justify a single start), independently optimize the candidates and validate stationary geometry, connectivity and electronic convergence. Record candidate selection and any numerical-sensitivity results. For each selected validated geometry, report its neutral HOMO and global index on the defined scale, plus at least one consistently defined local descriptor at both mapped amine N sites, with units, formula, population/sampling convention and artifact evidence. Analyze equivalent-site asymmetry and conflicting descriptor rankings instead of silently exchanging scales.

Report the acute least-squares angle between the two mapped aromatic ring planes, plane-fit residuals, and all separately mapped continuous linker torsions. Use the supplied atom maps and sign convention; PFMB's central linker is the bond between mapped atoms 3 and 12. A four-atom torsion is not the ring-plane angle. Include final geometry and an output-index-to-map-ID mapping so every geometry observable can be independently re-extracted.

Completion requires all three diamines' validated observables and exactly one record per supplied molecule. TMC uses `context_only`; a failed diamine uses `bounded_failure` with attempted evidence and consequences. Report the ordering implied by each descriptor and the overall conclusion supported by those computed descriptors; do not fabricate missing quantities or claim an unperformed exhaustive search.

# Deliverables

Submit `report/results.json` conforming to `submission_schema.json`, including methods, conformer/validation evidence, identity-bound global and local quantities, mapped ring-plane angles and linker torsions, ordering. Cite final geometries, neutral/probe electronic outputs and extraction artifacts. These data, not a remembered ranking, must support the conclusion.

Scientific completion requires all requested primary observables, the specified validation evidence and the resulting scientific comparison. A partial or failed calculation may be submitted with its actual results and diagnostics, but does not satisfy an uncomputed scientific result.

Additional starting structures or investigations may be used to obtain the required results. Report auxiliary results separately; they do not replace the primary observables or their specified definitions. Optional analyses may be omitted without explanation or penalty.

Computational Details

 All density functional theory (DFT) calculations were carried out using Gaussian 16,1 employing

the hybrid B3LYP functional2 augmented with Grimme’s D3 dispersion correction using the Becke–

Johnson (BJ) damping scheme.3,4 Geometries were optimized with the SDD effective core potential5

for Ru and the 6-31G(d,p) basis set6,7 for all other atoms (S, C, N, O, H). Vibrational frequency

analyses were performed at the same level of theory to confirm the nature of each stationary point

(minimum or transition states) and to provide Gibbs free energy corrections at 298.15 K. Single-point

energies were refined using the def2-TZVP basis set8 for all atoms with the SMD continuum solvation

model9 to account for acetonitrile solvent effects.

 The experimental absolute redox potential of the standard hydrogen electrode (SHE, 4.52 V)10

was utilized to calculate redox potentials, which was established as −0.028(4) V11 vs the

ferrocenium/ferrocene couple. Consequently, standard redox potentials were computed relative to the

ferrocenium/ferrocene (Fc⁺/0) couple, taken as 4.548 V in acetonitrile, corresponding to an absolute

electron affinity of 104.879 kcal/mol.

 For pKa calculations, the Gibbs free energy of a proton in acetonitrile was taken as –264.7

kcal/mol, incorporating both its experimental solvation free energy (–258.4 kcal/mol)12,13 and a gas-

phase translational entropy correction (–6.3 kcal/mol) 14. The pKa of NH₄⁺ was estimated at 15.1 when

modeled as the [NH₄⁺⋯NH₃] dimer, consistent with the experimental value (15.6) 15, and this value was

used as a pH reference. The Gibbs energy for proton-coupled electron transfer (PCET) was calculated

as 390.2 kcal/mol based on the expression: GPCET = 104.879 + 264.7 + 1.364 × pH, using pH = 15.1.

Standard state corrections were applied: +1.9 kcal/mol for species undergoing a 1 atm to 1 M

concentration change, and +3.6 kcal/mol for acetonitrile, as its standard state concentration of 19.2 M.

Unless otherwise noted, all reported energies include Gibbs corrections and D3(BJ) dispersion.

Molecular structures were visualized using CYLView.16 Visual molecular dynamics (VMD) software17

and the Multiwfn program18 were used in the orbitals visualization.

unreacted (no 1,2-diphenylethane was detected by GC–MS).


4. Computational Methods and Results

4.1 Computational Methods

 All the calculations were performed on the Gaussian 16 (A.03) program package.[15]
Considering the applicability of PBE0 functional on computing the energy barriers of
organic and organometallic reactions in solution,[16] the hybrid PBE0[17] functional in
conjugation with the def2-SVP basis set[18] and the D3 version of Grimme’s dispersion
correction with Becke-Johnson damping (GD3-BJ)[19] was used for structure
optimization. The corresponding frequency analysis at the same level was conducted to
characterize the nature of the optimized structures; i.e., energy minimums without
imaginary frequencies or transition states with only one imaginary frequency; and the
imaginary model connects the initial and the final states. On the basis of
PBE0(GD3BJ)/def2-SVP-optimized geometries, MN15 functional[20] in conjugation
with the def2-TZVP basis set were used to calculate the self-consistent reaction field
(SCRF) single-point energies in the solvation of N,N-dmethylacetamide (MN15-
SCRF(SCRF)/def2-TZVP//PBE0/def2-SVP) by using the SMD solvation model.[21]
Graphics with 3D rending in ball-and-stick model was drawn in CYLview 1.0
visualization software.[22] The spin density on INT-C was analyzed by the wavefunction
analysis program Multiwfn 3.8.[23]

The author route compares closure onto the benzyl-tethered aryl ring (label `ts2`) with closure onto the arenesulfonyl aryl ring (`ts2_prime`), using the uncyclized radical minimum (`intermediate_B`) as their common energy reference. This guidance specifies the channels, not their geometry or energetic preference.

# Public inputs and scientific boundaries

`data/inputs/system.json` defines the complete C21H24F2NO4S radical by SMILES, explicit connectivity and atom mapping; `data/inputs/radical_starter.xyz` is an independently graph-generated 53-atom initial conformation in Å, not an optimized minimum or TS. Use charge 0, multiplicity 2. Locate and validate the reference minimum and cyclization saddles yourself. The primary model is an isolated molecule with implicit DMSO, using consistent harmonic Gibbs energies at 298.15 K and 1 atm. State software, method, basis, dispersion and thermochemical settings. Other conditions may be controls. Photocatalyst, zinc acetate, explicit solvent and subsequent oxidation/aromatization are outside this cyclization comparison. No paper, SI, evaluator, historical verification archive or general-web lookup is an agent input.

# Required scientific validation/investigation

Optimize the radical reference and locate the two distinct aryl-cyclization saddles. Validate zero imaginary modes for the reference and one relevant mode for each saddle. Retain final geometries, `atom_mapping` (one public-input atom index per output-geometry row) and the forming C–C atom pair (1-based rows of that output geometry); inspect the negative mode to verify the assigned ring closure. IRC/endpoint following may strengthen the assignment but is not mandatory. Compute ΔG‡ = G(saddle) − G(reference) consistently in kcal/mol. Independent conformer and TS searches are allowed; do not infer a transition structure from an input filename.

Submit `report/results.json` and the geometry/calculation evidence it cites. Use state keys `intermediate_B`, `ts2`, `ts2_prime` and barrier fields `barrier_ts2`, `barrier_ts2_prime`; `barrier_difference` means ts2_prime minus ts2. `complete` requires all three validated states and numerical barriers. Otherwise use `bounded_failure` with available evidence and a specific reason; unavailable numerical results may be omitted. Extra attempts may be recorded separately.

 Inspired by this work, we investigated heptazines substituted
by three aromatic groups as scaffolds for the development of new
photocatalysts having both high oxidative potency and tunable
properties (Figure 1C). We hereby report the synthesis and full
characterization of a representative set of four photoredox
catalysts based on this design. They can be excited by visible
light, and exhibit oxidative potentials up to +1.69 V vs SCE,
combined with excited-state lifetimes up to 72 ns. Furthermore,
we demonstrate the application of one catalyst to the selective
aerobic photo-oxidation of C−H and C−C bonds in nitrogen-
containing molecules, significantly expanding the substrate
scope to include electron-deficient nitrogen compounds such as
amides, ureas, carbamates, and sulfonamides. This catalyst also
shows remarkable selectivity, enabling targeted oxidation in
complex molecules bearing multiple nitrogen atoms.

### paper_c625cba3ce868eb1 # Scientific objective

Test the authors' qualitative hypothesis that the allylic hydroperoxide in neutral, closed-shell (R)-4 polarizes the adjacent C=C bond, whereas hydroperoxide-free neutral, closed-shell alkenol 7 has electronically comparable alkene sites. Independently plan and execute calculations that compare the reactant-state molecular electrostatic potential/electronic density and atom-resolved electrostatic-potential-derived partial charges of the two molecules in aqueous solution. This is a reactant-state electronic comparison, not a request to calculate a transition state, product ordering, or reaction energy.

# Author-provided scientific guidance

**Author hypothesis or claim.**
The authors propose that the allylic hydroperoxide in neutral, closed-shell (R)-4 changes the reactant-state electron-density distribution at the nearby C=C bond, while hydroperoxide-free neutral, closed-shell alkenol 7 has electronically comparable alkene sites. They present this as a plausible reactant-state electronic rationale for later regioselectivity, not as proof of a reaction mechanism.

**Candidate route or mechanism.**
Focus the comparison on hydroperoxide-associated polarization: assess whether the alkene carbon proximal to the hydroperoxide is electronically distinct from the distal carbon in 4, and compare that asymmetry with the two equivalent alkene sites of 7. Treat the proposed relationship to downstream 6-exo-trig haloetherification as a comparison hypothesis rather than a conclusion.

**Discriminating evidence.**
Use consistently computed molecular electrostatic potential or electronic-density descriptors and electrostatic-potential-derived atom-resolved partial charges, especially the signed difference between the two alkene carbons in each molecule. Validate the electronic states and use the same charge definition for the cross-molecule comparison.

# Public inputs and scientific boundaries

The public inputs are `data/inputs/compound_4_R.xyz` (33 atoms, explicit atom order, (R)-4) and `data/inputs/compound_7.xyz` (25 atoms, explicit atom order, 7). They are fixed, answer-neutral benchmark conformers supplied as Cartesian inputs; do not claim to reproduce a hidden optimized geometry. Treat both systems as neutral closed-shell singlets. In 4, the alkene is atoms 2 and 4 and atom 2 is bonded through atom 1 to hydroperoxide oxygen atom 22; report [2, 4] as [hydroperoxide-proximal, distal]. In 7, the alkene is atoms 8 and 10; report [8, 10] in increasing atom-index order because the sites are chemically equivalent for this comparison. Preserve atom order. The physical boundary is an isolated molecule represented in aqueous solution by the chosen computational treatment. No enzyme, brominating reagent, solvent molecule, transition state, intermediate, or product structure is supplied or required. You may choose software, electronic-structure method, solvation model, charge partition, and additional conformers, but must state them. Do not use the paper, SI, general web, or hidden evaluator as an input.

# Required scientific validation/investigation

Consistently evaluate both supplied conformers at a justified electronic-structure/solvation level; geometry optimization is optional and must not replace reporting results for the supplied conformers. Validate each reported electronic state with SCF/convergence and wavefunction or equivalent state checks, and, if you optimize, also report frequency/Hessian evidence and any imaginary modes. Retain atom identity through all transformations. Compute an MEP/electrostatic-potential descriptor and atom-resolved charges for both molecules, and report the two alkene-carbon charges and their signed difference for each molecule. Compare the hydroperoxide-containing and hydroperoxide-free cases using the same charge definition. If you explore conformers or method sensitivity, describe generation, deduplication, selection/advancement, and coverage. Scientific completion requires all requested primary observables, the specified validation evidence and the resulting scientific comparison. A partial or failed calculation may be submitted with its actual results and diagnostics, but does not satisfy an uncomputed scientific result.

# Deliverables

Submit `report/results.json` and any supporting files needed to reproduce it. The JSON must contain: `status` (`complete` or `bounded_failure`); per-molecule `molecules` entries keyed by `compound_4_R` and `compound_7`, each with `atom_count`, `alkene_carbon_indices`, `charges` (atom-indexed numeric array when available), `charge_definition`, `validation` and `method`; `comparison` with signed alkene-charge differences and a qualitative polarization statement; `coverage`; and `provenance`. A complete result must include numeric charges for every atom of each molecule, validation evidence for each molecule, and enough method/provenance detail to reproduce the analysis. A bounded failure must truthfully identify which required artifact could not be produced, report attempted validation and coverage, and may omit unavailable charge arrays while retaining per-molecule identity, method, charge definition, and validation records.

Additional starting structures or investigations may be used to obtain the required results. Report auxiliary results separately; they do not replace the primary observables or their specified definitions. Optional analyses may be omitted without explanation or penalty.


### paper_d3b4575397179146 # Scientific objective

Independently plan and execute a computational test of the authors' qualitative explanation for the optical properties of the four explicitly identified triaryl-heptazines in `data/inputs/heptazines.json`. For each molecule, determine a validated neutral-singlet ground-state structure, vertical singlet excitations, oscillator strengths and dominant orbital contributions, then test whether the reported visible-band assignment and frontier-orbital localization are supported. The authors' qualitative hypothesis is that substituent-controlled frontier orbitals produce distinct weak visible transitions; independently test this hypothesis without assuming any numerical result or winning state.

# Author-provided scientific guidance

**Author hypothesis or claim.**
The authors propose that substituent-controlled frontier orbitals account for distinct weak visible transitions in this triaryl-heptazine series. Their interpretation distinguishes derivatives whose frontier density remains chiefly associated with the heptazine nitrogen core from a dimethoxy-substituted derivative in which the highest occupied density is shifted toward the aryl substituents. They further associate the relevant weak visible band with a frontier-orbital excitation for the fluoro-, chloro-, and methyl-substituted members, while proposing a lower occupied orbital to LUMO excitation for the dimethoxy member.

**Candidate route or mechanism.**
Test a substituent-dependent electronic-state assignment across the four molecules: compare core- versus aryl-localized HOMO/LUMO density, then examine whether the selected weak visible transition is dominated by HOMO→LUMO or instead by a lower occupied orbital→LUMO contribution. Treat these as candidate assignments to be checked on the independently obtained structures and excited states.

**Discriminating evidence.**
Use validated optimized neutral-singlet geometries, low-lying vertical singlet energies and wavelengths, oscillator strengths, dominant orbital contributions, and a reproducible orbital-density localization analysis. Compare the assignment and localization trends across all four compounds; the calculations should determine whether the proposed state character is supported.

# Public inputs and scientific boundaries

The four systems are identified by stable local IDs, complete names, formulas, SMILES, charge 0 and multiplicity 1 in the input JSON. Use those structures as the molecular identity; do not infer alternative protonation, connectivity or atom mapping. The physical system is an isolated molecule with implicit acetonitrile solvation. The measured quantities are ground-state minimum validation, vertical singlet excitation energies/wavelengths, oscillator strengths, dominant orbital transitions, and qualitative spatial localization of HOMO/LUMO (and any orbitals needed for the selected band). Solid-state packing, vibronic structure, fluorescence lifetimes, catalytic yields and reaction mechanisms are outside scope. The author route may be considered as a qualitative hypothesis, but paper-specific software, model chemistry, ordered protocol, numerical tables and answer-bearing orbital figures are not supplied.

# Required scientific validation/investigation

For all four named molecules, choose and document a defensible electronic-structure workflow. Generate or optimize at least one 3-D conformer per molecule, retain the conformer actually used, and report charge, multiplicity, convergence and whether a frequency analysis supports a minimum (or explicitly report a bounded failure). Calculate enough low-lying singlet states to cover the first visible/near-visible absorption and report state number, energy, wavelength, oscillator strength and dominant orbital contributions. Define visible as 380–700 nm and state how the band is selected when multiple states occur. Inspect orbital densities using a stated reproducible criterion and identify whether HOMO and LUMO density is primarily on the heptazine core or peripheral aryl substituents. Deduplicate equivalent states only when the submitted evidence explains the criterion. Scientific completion requires all requested primary observables, the specified validation evidence and the resulting scientific comparison. A partial or failed calculation may be submitted with its actual results and diagnostics, but does not satisfy an uncomputed scientific result.

# Deliverables

Submit `report/results.json` conforming to `submission_schema.json`. Include per-system structures and validation, transitions, orbital-localization observations, comparison to the qualitative hypothesis, computational provenance. Include enough evidence paths or excerpts from the agent's own outputs to make each object-specific claim auditable. Do not reproduce the paper or SI as a substitute for calculations.

Additional starting structures or investigations may be used to obtain the required results. Report auxiliary results separately; they do not replace the primary observables or their specified definitions. Optional analyses may be omitted without explanation or penalty.

Generation of model compounds by (Et2N)3P and PA for sodium ethoxide

activation studies.

 A 10 mL sample vial was prepared by drying it in an oven at 110°C for more than

4 h and then immediately transferring it to a glovebox filled with an argon atmosphere.

preparation were divided into two equal molar amounts of the product, one portion was

from pathlib import Path

 out=[]

 registries={}
 for pid in IDS:
  folder=DEST/pid/'agent_input/data/inputs';reg=json.loads((folder/'species_registry.json').read_text());registries[pid]=reg
  for s in reg['species']:
   tag=pid+':identity:'+s['id']
   if 'mapped_smiles' in s:
    pa=Chem.SmilesParserParams();pa.removeHs=False;m=Chem.MolFromSmiles(s['mapped_smiles'],pa)

 for name in ['4b','4c','4h','4i']:
  s=species('paper_fcc3c7f2c46a0fbe',name);oh=any(a['element']=='O' for a in s['real_H_donors'])
  check('antioxidant:'+name+':actual_OH_identity',oh==(name in ['4c','4i']))
 reg=registries['paper_e2d9397dff2a3f0f'];state=reg['construction_definitions']['state_definition'];check('Ru:changed_ligand_inventory',state['bcs']['atom_count']==49 and state['bcs']['replace_element']=={'28':'S'})
 reg=registries['paper_9132719dbf91c978'];check('Pd:full_hydride_inventory',reg['metal_graph']['hydride_maps']==[76,77])
 short=species('paper_8fefc96b015c4577','radical_starter');long=species('paper_8fefc96b015c4577','long_radical')
 check('radical:long_complete_homologous_atoms',len(long['homologous_atoms'])==56 and len({a['map_id'] for a in long['homologous_atoms']})==56)
 counts=Counter(a['element'] for a in long['homologous_atoms']);check('radical:homologous_formula',counts==Counter({'C':22,'H':26,'F':2,'N':1,'O':4,'S':1}),dict(counts))
 edges={frozenset(b['atoms']) for b in long['homologous_bonds']};check('radical:sole_CH2_insertion',frozenset([13,14]) not in edges and all(frozenset(x) in edges for x in [[13,54],[54,14],[54,55],[54,56]]))
 for pid in ['paper_4e9774f4128551d3','paper_db6c4e0558113873']:
  check(pid+':old_answer_XYZ_private',not list((DEST/pid/'agent_input/data/inputs').glob('*.xyz')))
 for pid in IDS:
  matrix=json.loads((DEST/pid/'agent_input/data/inputs/research_matrix.json').read_text());check(pid+':three_core_panels',len(matrix['panels'])==3)
 return out
if __name__=='__main__':
 r=run();(B/'chemical_input_check_report.json').write_text(json.dumps({'boundary':'Graph/identity only; no quantum calculation','checks':r},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\\n');print(json.dumps([x for x in r if not x['passed']],ensure_ascii=False,indent=2));print('checks',len(r))

item.text:
**Optimizing fixture processes**

I’m looking into optimizing the fixture that uses jsonschema compilation for cost efficiency, as each call for the 32 panels seems quite expensive and takes a while, around 80 seconds. I’m thinking about splitting the scripts by making the command positional so I can manage selected papers more effectively. I will explore using batch records, ensuring each run remains stable under a timeout. Maybe, I should run multiple invocations concurrently to enhance performance while keeping the process organized and efficient!
**Improving script functionality**

I’m considering a multipackage script that aggregates distinct validation files while catching names. The checker will accept dynamic IDs from system arguments, only validating assigned stored originals, but I notice it's slow because it repeats the full repository every time. I want to incorporate a resume log and add a TEST_IDS filter for better control. This final run should finish in about three minutes. I also need to implement more robust semantic checks and ensure no new references that could lead to incorrect outputs. I must tighten the criteria for oxygen state enums and ensure everything is accurately audited!

## 4. 最低 B 方案：电子作用还是几何形变决定活化差异

建议提出的问题是：**在原文有限硅烯集合中，哪些受控计算支持“电子结构调节降低 H₂ 活化难度”，哪些差异主要来自接近和形变代价？** 最低集合明确为 **1、V′、4**。正文说明 4 将 1 中邻氨基的四配位碳位置改为羰基，因此用 1/4 形成有源文依据的结构对照，V′ 保留为已验证锚点。先做原子映射与结构核对，不因其他体系源文能垒更低就事后换对照。[正文 PDF p4](../../../papers/paper_0e835b370ddd37b6/documents/main.pdf#page=4)

| 位阻/骨架形变代价主导 | 沿同一反应坐标拆开反应物形变与相互作用，并保留片段电子态 | 主要能量差来自到达 TS 区域的形变代价 | 形变代价接近，而相互作用差解释了能垒差 |

## 5. 必需计算工作包与中间量

1. **身份和基线。** 核对 1、V′、追加结构与 SI 的骨架、取代、电荷、自旋；分别建立最低点、H₂ 和至少一个有效 H₂ 活化 TS。保留每种初猜的来源、收敛状态与去重理由。输出同一反应零点的 E、热修正和 G。
2. **最小构象覆盖。** 在 Si 邻域/取代基有柔性时生成有区别的进攻姿态，先筛选再做统一 DFT；检查得到的是同一反应而非骨架重排。一个低能 TS 只有在搜索范围明确时才可作该范围代表，不能宣称全局唯一。
3. **路径与能量分解。** 对保留 TS 做两端连接；沿相同 H–H 距离抽取少量可比点。以“中性硅烯＋中性 H₂”固定片段边界，计算各片段在复合体几何与自身平衡几何下的电子能，得到形变/相互作用的操作性分解。分片必须与已声明自旋和电子数一致。
4. **电子证据。** 在相同几何和统一布居方法下比较密度差、Si/H 原子或片段电荷、成键指标及必要轨道图。若 NBO 授权/接口未确认，用可重复的 Multiwfn 分析并明确不是源 NBO 数值；不强制不可用的专有分解。
5. **稳健性与判别。** 先用关键点单点检验另一泛函，再在差异可能改变结论时补优化/频率。分别报告电子能、热修正、溶剂和标准态影响；给出每种假设得到/失去支持的具体证据。

以上为科学工作包，不是“5 次计算”。实际启动计数需从新增作业记录取得；一个工作包可含多个引擎启动，单个 IRC/扫描启动也可含许多点。

## 6. 建议题面、输入及 evaluator

可用题面：**“在给定硅烯骨架和限定溶剂条件下，比较 H₂ 活化，并设计最小对照判断反应性差异主要与电子相互作用还是形变有关。提交能垒、有效反应连接和可否证的结构—反应性解释。”**

AR 公开结构身份、允许改变的单一位置、物理边界和预算，不公开获胜结构、作者 TS、论文能垒和机制归因；PR 可给作者结构和方法指导，终点相同。实验/论文信息供维护者建参考，不把本方案或私有结果挂入 agent 输入。

拟议评分至少覆盖：对象/态正确；可比较且连通的反应路径；统一定义的能垒；真正执行的几何/电子控制；依据控制选择或否定解释。每项必须链接输出；只有描述符、没有对照，不能获得“已解释原因”的分。数值容差由新增参考的重复性和模型波动校准，不直接沿用旧两个能垒的容差覆盖所有新量。

## 7. 工具可行性、资源与发布前条件

**有条件可行。** Gaussian/ORCA 已有同类真实 TS、频率与路径证据；RDKit/CREST/xTB 可作初猜和筛选，最终不得把低层路径当作 DFT 验证。Multiwfn 和原生单点可以完成最低分析；PyFrag 仅在分片定义和所需后端通过小体系试算后使用，不作为唯一验收依赖。

旧参考累计有效作业 elapsed 约 **108.1703 小时**，日志原生 CPU 时间约 **2107.0105 小时**；二者不是并行日历总跨度。扩大构象、增加结构和干预后不可承诺同样预算。先试算一个新增结构的基态和一个 TS，再据实际核数、内存、单次耗时和重启率制定预算，新增 CPU 核小时与墙钟目前均待测。

发布前必须完成：新增结构身份映射；至少一个受控结构对照的参考计算；同坐标分解的稳定性检查；盲输入到结果的有限试跑。若新增 TS 不可重复或各模型相反，保留真实负结果并缩小结论，不把更低层的预期数值填入参考。

## 8. 可选 C 扩展与边界

参考 B 闭合后，可限定原文 1–6 的改造规则，让 agent 自主生成少量候选，寻找“降低活化代价且不过度稳定加成产物”的折中。必须预先固定可编辑位点、价态、候选上限和独立验证预算，并保留未选候选证据。这才形成有限结构发现任务。最低版本不要求解决 CO₂ 全还原或整个氨硼烷脱氢循环，相关新通道必须另做参考验证。

def merge(a,b):

def sample(schema):

 typ=s.get('type','object' if 'properties' in s else 'string')
 if typ=='object':
  value={k:sample(s.get('properties',{}).get(k,{})) for k in s.get('required',[])}
  additions={}
  for c in s.get('allOf',[]):
   if 'if' in c and jsonschema.Draft202012Validator(c['if']).is_valid(value):additions=merge(additions,c.get('then',{}))
  if additions:
   s.pop('allOf',None);return sample(merge(s,additions))
  return value
 if typ=='array':
  contains=[x['contains'] for x in s.get('allOf',[]) if 'contains' in x]
  if 'contains' in s:contains.append(s['contains'])
  rows=[sample(merge(s.get('items',{}),c)) for c in contains]
  while len(rows)<s.get('minItems',0):rows.append(sample(s.get('items',{})))
  return rows
 if typ in ['number','integer']:
  if 'exclusiveMaximum' in s:return s['exclusiveMaximum']-1
  return max(s.get('minimum',1),s.get('exclusiveMinimum',0)+1)
 if typ=='boolean':return False

**边界。** 不要求在本轮首版完成全部光化学非绝热轨迹，也不把基态最低产物称为唯一光产物。

**需要满足的条件。** 不能用未校准距离阈值定义“所有候选”；最低 C 应完成有意义的竞争连接比较，若光态可达性未解决则收缩结论。

## 5. 竞争解释与可证伪判断

1. H1：几何接近且连续可达的顺序环化解释选择性。
2. H2：截止外构象/竞争闭环同样可达，端点能排序不足。

这些是出题方用于验证任务设计的候选解释，不应全部连同结果预先公开给 AR agent。正式题允许 agent 提出等价、可检验的解释；关键是有计算能改变其判断，而不是只在报告里写“存在若干假设”。

## 6. 具体计算、关键中间量和判断顺序

下列是参考开发的工作安排，**不是实际命令调用次数**；可合并或拆分求解器作业，按原始执行记录统计真实计算。

1. 枚举合理闭环连接和反应顺序，加入临界距离附近及不同构象候选，报告去重和排除依据。
2. 以 xTB 预筛选但用 DFT 精化所有低能与临界候选，分别给出各步产物与反应物组成。
3. 对决定选择性的局部闭环建立路径证据；若涉及光态，明确所用势面和基态模型不能回答的部分。
4. 预先固定能窗和路径完整性要求，保留未能排除的产物集合，并用正文实际产物作为独立判据。

每个关键比较必须同时保留对象身份、几何/电子态、方法、收敛与输出；排序须在同一物理定义和误差范围内比较。先做上述最低科学范围，只有新增条件和参考均齐备后才启用更大扩展。

## 7. 公开输入、隐藏信息与 AR 题目建议

**输入整理。** 公开完成本题所需的分子/材料身份、原子映射、组成/电荷/自旋边界、实验介质与温度、可测观测及其误差；把原文图谱整理为有来源的数值，不以插值增加测量点。当前任务已经合法给定的属性对象可以保留；若新题改为发现结构/路径，需重新检查这些给定坐标是否直接暴露答案。

**隐藏内容。** 隐藏作者选定的解释、最终候选排序、目标数字、TS/产物答案和参考计算；PR 可以在相同科学边界下提供作者路线，但完成要求相同。不要只隐藏论文标题却保留答案几何与标签。

organic and organometallic reactions in solution,[16] the hybrid PBE0[17] functional in 
conjugation with the def2-SVP basis set[18] and the D3 version of Grimme’s dispersion 
correction with Becke-Johnson damping (GD3-BJ)[19] was used for structure

PBE0(GD3BJ)/def2-SVP-optimized geometries, MN15 functional[20] in conjugation 
with the def2-TZVP basis set were used to calculate the self-consistent reaction field

SCRF(SCRF)/def2-TZVP//PBE0/def2-SVP) by using the SMD solvation model.[21]

## 3. 科学边界与来源纠正

1. **苄醇：** Iₑ 与 Dₑ 均为约定的电子能差，不混入 ZPE/G，不把气相电离当绝对电极电位。单一 H 原子参考必须一致。检验预测可为数值或排序；已经看过结果时如实采用回顾检验，不能补造盲预测历史。
2. **环氧片段：** 作者方法段是 B3LYP-D3(BJ)，图注出现 CAM-B3LYP 的不一致已在 PR 中披露。以方法段为复现基线、其他层级单独列。分子偶极不等于树脂 Dk；对任意取向偶极向量求和不能代替 ⟨μ²⟩。
3. **并环戊搭烯：** NICS 使用完整张量对分子法向投影。源文正文和 SI 的响应基组不一致，PR 明确采用 SI 基线并披露差异。冻结骨架控制不能冒充自由极小值。
4. **锌配合物：** 对角 G 和交叉几何电子能分开；允许真实构象塌缩，不强造四个不同极小值。后 SCF D3 的同几何开关不能被解释成直接电子密度干预。红移与增强振子强度分开判断。
5. **铱硝酸根：** 从公开输入移出直接揭示 eta2 的旧 X-ray 参数，改为不固定金属—硝酸根连接的组成定义和未指派 IR。PR 将 eta2 作为作者假设提供。1532/1261/1223/802 与另含 1561 cm⁻¹ 的两套观测均需比较；源文没有明确通用数值缩放因子，不能冒称作者给定。
6. **发色团：** 补入 PQCZCS 的完整身份；其与 AQ 是同分异构体，不可混为一物；SI `[M+H]+` 分子式不作为中性计算式。AR 不预先提供特定分子的 CT/局域态赢家；PR 作者解释与新增共同扭角设计分开。

## 4. 科学评分和完成标准

科学评分总分为 100：对象/有效性 10，三项各篇特定研究端点合计 65，实际假设检验和定量稳健性 15，有证据的结论 10。新增对照、能量分解、系综或态匹配都进入评分，旧标量加一段机制文字不足以完成新版。

评分规则要求从原始文件核对定义、覆盖、数值相减、权重、张量投影、谱残差或态对应。对于拓展范围，现阶段使用有具体证据要求的条件/语义规则；**尚未伪造新的数值参考和容差**。源文数值及旧实际结果仅作为相同定义的基线参考；完整新增参考和方法敏感性建立后，才可冻结可接受数值范围。

计算支持作者、反驳作者，或完成充分对照后仍存在不可区分性，都可构成有效科学结论。少算一个必需端点、一次不收敛或没有执行对照，不等于完成了“不可识别性”研究。`bounded_failure` 可被提交格式接受，但不自动获得科学通过。

不得强迫后续 AR agent 采用唯一控制路线。出题方的控制矩阵用于证明可行性和设定科学覆盖；正式题公开研究问题、可用数据、有限对象/预算与完成标准，让 agent 自主选择能区分解释的实际计算。等价且科学充分的对照可被接受。

## 3. 建立可审查的新参考

1. **先导验证。** 先复核一个正确旧端点，再运行本篇指定的最关键新增控制。旧端点与当前任务不同就先解释版本/身份/物理量差异，不能复制旧PASS。软件自测与此处的科学端点是两回事。
2. **最低完整参考。** 实际完成顶部规格的核心矩阵，保留初猜、失败/重启和最终结构。固定几何点用于干预诊断，不冒充自由极小值。非平稳点不得随意套用其他结构的热修正。路径对照要证明反应坐标与端点，不能只凭一个虚频。
3. **可否证性。** 至少一项对照确实能挑战首选解释。计算支持作者、否定作者、或在测定误差内不可区分都可以是科学结果；但“没有算到必需端点”只能是未完成，不等于有界不可识别。
4. **稳健性。** 对决定结论的一个模型/方法/构象/数值设置作敏感性检查。若排序差小于不确定度，定义支持集合或不可排序区间，不能强制单个赢家。
5. **冻结数值。** 将源文值、旧真实结果、新增参考值和推断分列。新容差依据实验提取误差、数值收敛、方法/构象敏感性和等价路线参考确定；相对变化与绝对值分别校准。不得机械沿用旧端点的±阈值，更不得事后放宽到覆盖任意错误对象。

## 4. evaluator 的最低实现要求

实施时不必照抄以下文件名，但必须有同等可追溯关系：对象表、原始作业索引、主观测/控制差异表、假设–证据–结论表、资源记录、公开/私有数据清单。它们是出题方参考设计，不能把作者路线或赢家经这些文件泄露给AR。

验收顺序：

1. **身份与有效性**：守恒、原子映射、电子态、收敛、驻点/路径/周期模型符合要求。
2. **必需计算覆盖**：顶部核心矩阵中每一科学比较有真实结果，允许有证据的候选坍缩/排除，但不将一次不收敛当全空间不存在。
3. **可重算数值**：从引用的原始文件能重算关键量及差值，定义/单位一致，数值满足已冻结的参考范围。
4. **科学判断**：结论与干预及反例一致，指出仍无法区分的因素；不依赖照抄作者叙述获取高分。

发布前至少准备四类评分样例：完整有效结果；完成对照后得到合理否定/不可识别；只提交旧数值而缺新控制；错身份/错态/错能量零点。新框架必须拒绝后两类，不把格式分或“诚实失败”加到科学通过。可选扩展不计入首版硬失败。

AR/PR 使用同一个科学对象、观测定义、容差和完成判据。PR可暴露作者路线，AR保留独立研究选择。实际结果可证明同一科学问题可计算，但不能补造历史AR自主决策轨迹。

## 5. 软件范围与替代边界

以当前完整版 [chemistry_toolbox](../../../chemistry_toolbox/README.md)、[原生程序指南](../../../chemistry_toolbox/config/native_software_guides.yaml)、[运行时配置](../../../chemistry_toolbox/config/mcp_profiles.yaml) 为依据。原生入口缺少专用Action不等于软件不能算；软件存在也不等于具体新模型已验证。

| 科学工作 | 默认参考工具范围 | 需要额外校准的边界 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 分子基态/频率/热化学 | Gaussian或ORCA；CREST/xTB辅助初猜；GoodVibes可作统一热化学后处理 | xTB最低点/势垒不直接顶替目标DFT；不同程序的同名溶剂/色散/基组先核对 |
| TD、NMR、ECD、响应、EPR | Gaussian/ORCA原生功能，Multiwfn等分析已导出的波函数/密度 | NTO/态映射、核种/符号、响应张量、SOC与根窗口；功能存在不等于可靠方法 |
| TS/IRC/有限机制 | Gaussian/ORCA与pysisyphus；PyFrag仅在碎片及路径定义一致时使用 | 同一势面端点、守恒、局部/共同零点、标准态；扫描峰不是自动TS |
| 统计/连续模型 | 允许的Python/SciPy环境 | 必须有真实数据、物理模型和可识别性，不能拟合任意函数冒充机制 |
| 周期/表面/界面 | GPAW/QE/CP2K等已配置后端，ASE辅助 | 赝势、晶胞、磁态、表面/真空/k点及尺寸收敛按本题建立 |
| 多参考/能量分解/体相/输运 | 按单篇有条件启用ORCA/PySCF/Psi4/GROMACS等 | 活性空间、碎片、力场、电荷、采样和接口各有独立参考要求；NEGF仍在阻塞队列 |

首版不要求安装新商业软件。将NBO等许可或专门接口列为必需之前先核实实际可调用范围；替代分析需证明支持同一科学观测，不能静默更换量的定义。SIESTA的现有原生指南仅列siesta入口，不能由此推定完整偏压TBtrans链已允许且跑通。

## 6. 资源与每批完成条件

资源逐作业记录：实际科学引擎启动数、成功/失败/重启、分配CPU核数、有效计算小时、CPU核小时；有进程累计CPU时间则单独列。作业小时求和与并行日历跨度分列。多段Link1/多个扫描点未重新启动引擎时不分别计启动；后处理分析不算科学引擎调用。估算值必须标预计，参考完整跑完后才填实测。

批次不是必须整批成功后才能继续的硬依赖。某篇满足自身入口和资源条件可推进，另一篇阻塞则留在准备队列。每篇完成顺序为：数据和定义冻结 → 最关键控制试算 → 最低完整参考及稳健性 → 两模式任务/评分同步 → 无作者答案泄露的独立试运行 → 对照原始结果审查。未完成新增参考时，只能称“方案/参考开发中”，不能称“升级版验证通过”。
